summary: A 16 oz claw hammer, 0.33 m: an oval hickory handle with a swelled grip and flared butt, a forged steel head… options grip, head_finish; sockets grip_r, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.hammer or place "prefab": "hammer" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
